body:
Hey team,

This pull request aggregates all the stacked pull requests already tests/validated in isolation that migrate 45% connectors/widgets to TypeScript.

Remember, we are now targeting the **master**.

You can check the remaining state of this mission here: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/discussions/4407.

Please would be cool if you could checkout this branch locally, and test a typed built with your current projects with specific focus on: 

- breadcrumb
- clear-refinements
- configure
- confirure-related-items
- current-refinements
- hits
- hits-per-page
- infinive-hits
- panel
- autocomplete
